name: Weighted Lookup Table Computation
definition: Generation of lit pre-integration tables (specular and diffuse) by applying scaling functions (ramp functions) to transfer function colors during integration. Front-weighted tables have ramp value 1 at front sample and 0 at back; back-weighted are reversed.
summary: Weighted Lookup Table Computation generates pre-integrated tables with spatially varying lighting by combining three intermediate tables, unlike standard methods that assume uniform lighting.
